status: PASS: artifact acknowledgment 1/1; complete agents configuration 22/22; combined ChatView suite 6/6. Earlier failed and overlapping attempts retained.
method: Request counts and timings are extracted from each retained Playwright trace.zip, 0-trace.network. Non-API counts include documents, CSS, fonts and scripts, so they are not JavaScript-module counts. Start offsets use the first network request in each trace. These runs are diagnostic observations, not a controlled performance benchmark.
provenance: Published candidate artifact failure preceded acknowledgment assertions, with the checked checkbox present in the terminal snapshot. Its first bootstrap request began at +4769.7 ms.

The unchanged merged artifact failure is distinct: split-workspace and profiles endpoints returned 404, and the terminal snapshot remained New conversation. Upstream canonical placement no longer selects the thread solely from Snapshot.activeThreadId.
The unchanged merged agents reproduction passed both selected cases. The inherited child follow-up receipt correction came from main; this work does not claim that correction.
The isolated agents fixture eagerly imported App even for candidate=false. Moving that import into the candidate branch removed App and SourceWorkbench network requests from isolated cases.

The generic parent command fixture still returned id/status/result. The accepted-retry UI assertion failed with an unexpected-response message, then passed after the fixture returned commandId/eventSeq/result. Production parser semantics were not changed.
Canonical split support remains opt-in: serveTaskSplitLayout(page, initialThreadId?) seeds pane-main only when a caller supplies a thread. Generic serveTaskFixture behavior is unchanged.
Stable artifact-green-02 served the canonical layout successfully but exceeded the initial five-second checkbox assertion during cold module loading.

Artifact-green-03 waits for the real Review records table in the canonical task-thread view before the first original checked-state assertion. Its trace shows that assertion begins at +5545.1 ms with the original 5000 ms assertion timeout.

The first complete agents run exposed cold App import time in its integration case. Candidate-only setup now waits for its existing fixture mount marker, retaining all API request history before unchanged no-snapshot assertions.
The migrated Escape and IME cases mount real ChatView and TooltipLayer. The upstream three-case canonical chat-view-modes spec remains byte-identical to main.
